question: Should OpenClaw continue supporting or backporting the legacy `skills/skill-creator/scripts/init_skill.py --resources` helper, or treat it as obsolete now that current main routes durable skill creation through Skill Workshop?
rationale: Automation can verify the released parser bug and the linked fix, but current main intentionally removed the helper path and repository guidance now names Skill Workshop as the supported durable skill-creation surface.

options.title: Close obsolete helper path
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue together after confirming current main's Skill Workshop path is the intended replacement for the released helper.

options.title: Refresh and land the helper repair
options.body: Ask for or create a refreshed PR/backport that intentionally keeps the helper supported, resolves the current-main conflict, and adds the mixed-case parser tests.

recommendation.title: Close obsolete helper path
recommendation.body: Close the linked PR and this issue together after confirming current main's Skill Workshop path is the intended replacement for the released helper.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the original bundled skill-creator surface is the `7006a4a...` commit authored by Peter Steinberger.
